name: audit-projektu
description: Read-only logical and operational audit of a feed project across Mergado and its extensions (Pricing Fox, Bidding Fox, Feed Image Editor). Catalogue of 145 checks looking for nonsense in the data, contradictions between the name of a query or rule and its actual content, duplicate and dead rules, wrong rule order and cross-app conflicts between channels. Extensions that are unavailable or not enabled on the project are skipped and recorded in the report as unchecked.
